fillColor.description: Fill with a static color. HTML color name 'gray' => '#808080'

haloColorOnHover.description: Node outline color when hovered on.

outlineDashedProperty.description: Property of the data that determines whether the node is dashed or solid: true -> dashed, false -> solid.

labelStyle.description:
Node label style. This encompasses whether text, icon or image is shown in the node, and how those values
are determined.

size.description: The size of the nodes (static value).

sizeByProperty.description:
Property of the node data that determines the enlargement factor of the node.
If not set, {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeStyleConfig#size} is used as the fallback.
